notes.title: Patch Notes [April 30th, 2025 Demo V.1.0.1.1]
notes.content:
__Bug Fixes__
-Fixed save file issue that prevented returning to previous scenes before ||Darkhart.||
-Fixed ||FPS|| Frame rate issues.
-Balanced a number of encounters.
-A number of audio and visual tweaks.
-A bug that made the skybox briefly visible during some encounters at some resolutions.

__Known Issues__
- Working on: a way to reset your save data.
- A bug that causes visual issues with videos when ||opened in first person.||
- Occasionally dead enemies will be targeted.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1 [April 26th, 2025]
notes.content:
Patch Notes [April 26th, 2025 Demo V.1.0.1]

__Major Changes__
-Reworked Dialogue Options UI to be more Clear
-Rewrote a number of conversations to accommodate for new dialogue UI.
-Rewrote the [spoiler]Quizard[/spoiler] dialogue to not [spoiler]tell you the answers unless you get them all right[/spoiler].
-Added in music fading to a number of scenes. 
-Added location title cards to [spoiler]flashbacks and flash... forwards? [/spoiler]
-Music now fades in throughout the last ||boss encounter|| of the demo

__Bug Fixes__
-Fixed a number of bugs related to the game improperly saving what scenes you have been to.
-Fixed an issue where opening the [spoiler]inventory menu [/spoiler] would freeze the game.

__Known Issues__
-Working on: Balance changes to battles that prevent non-fun unintended effects
- Working on: a way to reset your save data
- A bug that causes visual issues with videos when ||opened in first person||
- Occasionally dead enemies will be targeted
- [spoiler] FPS Segments [/spoiler] have occasional stuttering on some devices
- A number of small visual and audio glitches
- Working on: a way to reset your save data
